over.beschikbaar_tekst: For a student job: after school, at weekends and during holidays, depending on my class schedule.
over.intro: Crossmedia student in Ghent, with a soft spot for typography, colour and details.
over.p1: My route: first STEM techniques, then Graphic Techniques, now Crossmedia at Don Bosco Sint-Denijs-Westrem. Along the way posters, print, websites, photography and film were added.
over.p2: I want to understand why a design works, and I test that in school projects and personal work. Besides designing, I play sports, love to travel and follow technology.
over.p3: What I’m looking for: a place to learn, to work with feedback and to contribute to real projects.
over.software_lijst: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Lightroom, Figma, HTML/CSS
privacy.beschrijving: Privacy and rights on the website of Afonso Matos da Cruz.
privacy.k2: What data does this website collect?
privacy.t1: Afonso Matos da Cruz, Ghent, Belgium. Contact: afonsomatos820@gmail.com.
privacy.t2: None automatically. The website uses no cookies, no analytics or tracking services and stores nothing in your browser. That is why there is no cookie banner. The hosting provider may keep technical log files, such as your IP address and the time of your visit; this is needed to run the site and keep it secure.
privacy.t3: If you fill in the form, your name, email address, subject and message are sent to my email address via the service Formspree, which acts as an external processor. I only use your details to reply and do not keep them longer than necessary. The same applies if you email me directly.
privacy.t4: The typefaces Instrument Serif and Inter Tight are loaded from this website itself; there is no connection to Google Fonts. Instagram and YouTube are plain links: only when you click them do you reach their websites, where their privacy rules apply.
privacy.t5: You can ask which data I hold about you, have it corrected or erased, or object to its use. Email me for this. You can also lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority (gegevensbeschermingsautoriteit.be).
privacy.t6: I made the designs, photos, films and texts on this website as a school assignment or personal project. You may not copy or reuse them without my permission. Some designs use other people’s imagery, such as photos or artworks, as part of a school assignment; the rights to that material remain with their owners. If you want something changed or removed, email me. The typefaces Instrument Serif and Inter Tight are licensed under the SIL Open Font License; the licence text is in the lettertypen folder.
privacy.titel: Privacy and rights — Afonso Matos da Cruz
project.disco.beschrijving: Disco Revisited: a school project by Afonso Matos da Cruz with moodboards, an editorial spread, a motion design video and two websites about disco and the Memphis movement.
project.disco.gemaakt: Moodboards, editorial spread, motion design, two websites
project.disco.intro: Disco as visual culture: big letters, mirror balls, colour and rhythm, starting from the film Saturday Night Fever (1977). First moodboards, then an editorial spread, a short video and two websites — one about disco, one about the Memphis group.
project.disco.moodboards.tekst: Two boards full of colour, shape and mood. Everything that followed was built from them.
project.disco.spread.tekst: ‘DISCO’ in outline letters, a yellow-orange subtitle, a violet field with a quote and a cut-out figure with a mirror ball as head. The text runs in columns and boxes around the images: from underground to mainstream, the sound, image and style, the 12-inch single.
project.disco.video.tekst: Short motion design video after Saturday Night Fever: light, rhythm and colour in motion.
project.disco.website1.tekst: The spread rebuilt for the web, with yellow subheadings, the video and a box about the 12-inch single. HTML and CSS, shown here as a screenshot.
project.disco.website2.tekst: About the Memphis movement, started in Italy in 1981 around Ettore Sottsass: bright colours, geometric shapes, patterns. HTML and CSS, shown here as a screenshot.
project.oostende.beschrijving: Seaside Bathing Culture in Ostend: a school project by Afonso Matos da Cruz with a visual style guide, an editorial spread, a character with animation and two websites.
project.oostende.gemaakt: Style guide, editorial spread, illustration with animation, two websites
project.oostende.intro: The history of bathing culture in Ostend, from the Belle Époque to today. I built a consistent visual world around it: first a style guide, then a spread, a character with animation and two websites, all in the same language.
project.oostende.ondertitel: From bathing machine to beach club
project.oostende.personage.tekst: A vector illustration of a figure with a black hat and blue apron, with zigzag lines as texture, and a short animation of it.
project.oostende.spread.tekst: Large title in Bodoni Moda, a cut-out bathing machine, wavy lines and columns about the birth of the seaside resort, elegance on the beach and the evolution of swimwear. At the bottom: then versus now.
project.oostende.stijlhandleiding.tekst: Four parts: typography, colour palette, colour variations, visual identity. Bodoni Moda for titles, Lora for running text. Storm Gray, Mist White and Sand Beige form the base; Slate Blue, Ochre Gold and Cream Ivory add to it; Rust Red is the sparing accent.
project.oostende.website1.tekst: Tourist site with eight places not to miss, a piece about the city and a contact form. HTML and CSS, shown here as a screenshot.
project.oostende.website2.tekst: Storytelling site in the style of the guide, with Story, Evolution and Image archive. HTML and CSS, shown here as a screenshot.
project.smak.affiche.tekst: For the 4D/A Graphic Techniques exhibition: a serif title with one coloured letter per word, and the pixel image as the main image.
project.smak.animatie.tekst: The same poster as a short animation. Light and shadow move subtly, giving the image a rhythm of its own.
project.smak.archiefdoos.tekst: An archive box says something about what is inside. I designed box and label, with care for layout and typography, for the feel of a historic city archive.
project.smak.archieffoto.tekst: An old photo from Ghent, extended in Photoshop with contemporary elements. With a few interventions, what the photo says changes.
project.smak.beschrijving: Image, Doubt & Construction: a school project by Afonso Matos da Cruz for an exhibition at the S.M.A.K. in Ghent, with poster, animation, stop-motion, pixel image, invitation and website.
project.smak.bomen.tekst: Bare trees seem caught by chance, but viewpoint, format, moment and frame are choices. Black and white turns the branches into almost a pattern. Inspired by the work of Marc De Blieck.
project.smak.gemaakt: Poster, animation, object, photo editing, stop-motion, photography, algorithmic image, invitation, website
project.smak.intro: For an exhibition at the S.M.A.K. we entered into dialogue with the photographs of Marc De Blieck. One question ran through every assignment: do you photograph what is there, or do you construct what the viewer sees? Ten parts, from poster to website.
project.smak.ondertitel: What do you see, and what do you build yourself?
project.smak.pixelbeeld.tekst: No sketch, but numbers: an online pixel tool turned one colour into a grid. In Illustrator I took swatches from the pattern and combined them with a generated circle structure. The algorithm supplied the material, I made the composition: 15×15 cm on a portrait format of 20×32 cm set by the Golden Ratio.
project.smak.schaduwaffiche.tekst: Starting from Plato’s cave, I made a poster that plays with what you can and cannot see. A lantern casts its shadow on a wall; ‘Umbra’ and ‘Light only shows him the way’ follow the diagonal.
project.smak.schimmenfilm.tekst: Stop-motion and shadow play about social media and identity: how reality becomes a constructed image.
project.smak.schimmenfilm.titel: The Real Behind The Perfect Picture
project.smak.uitnodiging.tekst: The pixel image becomes print. The front repeats title and image; the back invites guests to the exhibition and the reception on Saturday 2 May at 3 p.m.
project.smak.website.tekst: All assignments one under the other on one long page, each with heading, explanation and image. HTML and CSS, shown here as a screenshot.
